items.name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 28 AM 2022
items.information: BASC is proud to finally host a competition in the Bay Area's biggest city, San Jose! Join us at Andrew P. Hill High School for a jam-packed day of speedcubin'. # **IMPORTANT:** This competition is a TWIN COMPETITION. That means you may not compete in both BASC 28 AM and PM. # Competitors are limited to ONE guest.

items.name: Bologna New Year 2022
items.information: ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) ## **FFP2 MASKS ARE MANDATORY** Please check the [COVID-19 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BolognaNewYear2022#16860-covid-19) to understand the safety rules enforced at this competition. **Note: you will have to pay extra at the venue €10 if you are not a Cubing Italy member. It's free, discover how to in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BolognaNewYear2022/register).** --- ![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) ## **MASCHERINE FFP2 OBBLIGATORIE** Consulta la [sezione COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BolognaNewYear2022#16860-covid-19) per comprendere le norme di sicurezza della competizione. **Nota: dovrai pagare altri €10 in loco se non ti associ a Cubing Italy. È gratis, scopri come nella [sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BolognaNewYear2022/register).**
